objective: Measure whether task quality and within-model knowledge-versus-reasoning representation separation change along one Apertus 1.5 8B training trajectory.
claim_limit: The released final endpoint alone cannot identify change during training. Apertus 1.0 and 1.5 bundle continued pretraining, multimodal training, and post-training changes and therefore are not treated as adjacent checkpoints on one controlled trajectory.

runtime.reason: Apertus 1.5 support is not yet part of a released upstream Transformers version.

release_gate.model_card_statement: The technical report, training pipelines, and intermediate checkpoints will be published in the coming weeks.

planned_protocol.repeat_interpretation: The disjoint blocks are paired across checkpoints. Their sample standard deviation measures sensitivity to evaluation-example sampling, not variation across training seeds.

promotion_requirements: Discover at least two immutable checkpoints on the same documented training branch.
Inspect every checkpoint with the same pinned model implementation and verify 32 exact text-decoder layers.
Pass tracker-off/on logit and greedy-output parity before extraction.
Use identical task IDs, prompts, pooling, storage precision, and example blocks at every checkpoint.
Do not compare velocity across training stages unless cumulative training tokens or another common position unit is available.
